The Triton kernels, grid, scalars, compiled metadata, cache keys and allocation are unaffected.

expected: Under msprof L1 the launcher can read size() from both pointer arguments and the cached fast-path launch no longer raises AttributeError; non-profiled launches behave identically because the launcher derives addresses from the tensors.
